item.title: 2XKO already falls off PlayStation's top downloads chart in first full month, even below the shuttering Highguard
item.description: <p>After nearly a decade of development, <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/2xko/">2XKO</a> finally launched in full at the end of January, but the game may be struggling to recouperate those costs following so much time spent in the lab.</p> <p>Riot Games has continued to remain quiet on how their League of Legends fighting game is actually performing, and the latest indications don't help paint the best picture.</p>

item.title: Outfit 4 DLC revealed for Elena and Dee Jay in Street Fighter 6
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a>'s next big update is on the way, and <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/21/alex-gameplay-trailer-sf6/">Alex</a> isn't the only thing coming to the game this month.</p> <p>During today's <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/mar/05/capcom-spotlight-showcase-stream/">Capcom Spotlight</a> event, they revealed two new Outfit 4 DLC for Street Fighter 6.</p>

item.title: The top 10 worst fighting game character redesigns
item.description: <p>One of the coolest things about fighting games is seeing new character designs that can help tell the story of how they've changed and grown between titles, which is usually a treat to see.</p> <p>But what happens when those new fighter designs are a marked step down from what came before?</p>

item.title: Poll: Which Street Fighter 6 characters still need their Outfit 4 DLC the most and how should they be released?
item.description: <p>It only took five months, but <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a> is finally about to get the next batch of <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/mar/05/outfit-4-elena-deejay/">Outfit 4 DLC for Elena and Dee Jay</a>.</p> <p>That still leaves more than half of the game's roster, however, without a new costume, so who is most deserving or in need to be next on the list?</p>

item.title: Street Fighter 6 directly referenced one of pro wrestling's best memes of all time for Alex, and the Director clearly loves the stuff
item.description: <p>Fighting games are a super serious business, except the large amount of times that they aren't when the developers and players have a little goofy fun with the absurdity on display.</p> <p>Capcom themselves even leaned into the memes this week with <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/mar/03/alex-character-guide-sf6/">Alex's character guide showcase</a> for <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a>.</p>

item.title: Marvel vs. Capcom and Mortal Kombat are the two games I feel are most missed by the Fighting Game Community right now
item.description: <p>I was asked about the most missed titles in the Fighting Game Community on the <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w01iP6-BZTQ">StayMAD Podcast</a>, and I wanted to write about it here as well.</p> <p>I feel that Marvel vs. Capcom and Mortal Kombat are the two games that are most missed by the Fighting Game Community right now, as they would do the most for the collective scene if these franchises received new entries that were well received by gamers.</p>
